title: Rogan's reading on Project Blue Book, Hynek, Corso and Roswell

tellings.quote: I got really into Project Blue Book and I read a lot of the stuff on Jay Allen Heinik and you know and all the Philip Corso stuff and the stuff from Roswell

plain: The comedian and podcast host Joe Rogan tells Michels that he once went deep into the UFO record: he says he "got really into Project Blue Book", the US Air Force's UFO study of the 1950s and 60s, and read a lot about J. Allen Hynek, an astronomer tied to that study, about the claims of a former Army officer named Philip J. Corso, and about Roswell, the 1947 case in which something came down near Roswell, New Mexico, and many say it was a crashed craft. This is Rogan describing his own reading, not anything he saw, and he tells it to explain where his interest in the subject comes from.
